title: WKC advertises private deaddrop IDs unauthenticated defeating new ACL
description: File: python/src/lichen/coap/resources/deaddrop.py:593-599 (+ site.py:245 aggregation). Confirmed empirically: get_resources_as_linkheader lists /deaddrop/{id} for privacy='private' drops; any unauth client enumerates existence+IDs then probes 4.03 per ID. Privacy field introduced by y4ad diff undermines its own feature. Fix: filter linkheader to public drops or emit no per-drop links.
close_reason: Removed per-drop DeadDrop links from unauthenticated WKC because aiocoap's discovery hook has no request/OSCORE context; the /deaddrop collection remains advertised. Added public/private/group anonymous discovery, authenticated owner-vs-anonymous detail ACL, and cache-stability regressions. C/Zephyr advertises only the static /deaddrop resource and has no dynamic-ID analog. 79 focused DeadDrop/discovery tests, Ruff lint/format, scoped strict mypy, and diff check pass.
